title: C30: WaveTrend dots plus RSI divergence (sell tops with bearish, buy bottoms with bullish), 10m to 4h

what.name: Divergence
what.value_plain: newest high (low) in the last 8 bars beyond the extreme of bars 9-40 back while RSI is lower (higher); first RSI peak >= 60 (trough <= 40)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Trend
what.value_plain: any / same chart / last closed 2h bar
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10% per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

how: wt_rsi_div.py: 5m data built into 10m/15m/30m, 15m data into 1h/2h/4h. About 250 cells: treat every number as in-sample.
window: 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-31, split 2022-01..2024-06 vs 2024-07..now (whole history was read: a seen-period check, not a sealed test)

verdict.label: VALIDATION: H1 FAIL, H2 INCONCLUSIVE (mean +0.22 %, CI includes 0, Holm p 0.218). Not promoted; HOLDOUT unread.

why: 30m buy dot <= -53 + bullish divergence, exit at the centre line: n 88, win 80%, +0.35% net, both halves positive; it beats the same buy dots without divergence (95th percentile +0.22%) and random bars (+0.13%).
15m same rule with the 2h trend up, centre-line exit: n 44, win 75%, +0.26%, t 2.8.
Selected from about 250 cells on one period: needs a pre-registered read of 2024-07+ before anyone trusts it.

VALIDATION read 2024-07-01..2025-06-30 (pre-registered, c30_validation.py): H1 30m n 35 mean -0.07 % fee-net, FAIL; H2 15m with 2h trend up n 22 mean +0.22 %, 95 % CI -0.12..+0.56, Holm p 0.218, INCONCLUSIVE. HOLDOUT unread.
